class.name: SteamServerQuery
class.brief_description: Branchable filters for one scoped Steam dedicated server search.

method.name: on_map
method.description: Return a branch matching the exact world tag. The default accepts every compatible world.

method.name: with_room_for
method.description: Return a branch requiring 1 to 64 free seats. The default requires one seat.

method.name: under_latency
method.description: Return a branch capping latency at 1 to 60000 milliseconds. The default applies no additional latency cutoff.

method.name: limit
method.description: Return a branch with a 1 to 50 result cap. The default is 50.

method.name: fetch
method.description: Run the search and await its typed [SteamListingsResult]. The deadline accepts 100 to 15000 milliseconds. Eligible rows already copied by the deadline are returned when available.

method.name: fetch_operation
method.description: Run the same bounded search with an explicit cancellable operation. A scope permits one active search.
